content:
samir: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — dropping the pricing/credits/rate-limit thread here. post specific scenarios and i'll answer or loop folks in.

lina: are credits prorated if a customer upgrades mid-billing-cycle from free -> paid?

asha: short answer: yes. we prorate unused free-tier credits and apply them as a balance toward the paid plan for the remainder of the cycle. billing UI will show the adjustment line item.

devin: for Dedicated customers — is rate limiting enforced per-tenant/pool or globally? we saw a customer hit a cap even though they had reserved capacity.

emma: Dedicated gets isolated reserved pools and separate per-pool rate controls. that said, there are some global API safety checks that can still trigger (very rare). if you hit one of those we log the reason (capacity vs safety) — please share the request IDs and i'll have infra trace it.

samir: planned change: per-route quotas and ACLs are targeted for Q3 GA. we'll open an early-access waitlist next week for enterprise customers who want fine-grained quotas.

lina: how do embedding "units" map to tokens? customers are confused when embedding long docs and seeing both token and embedding billing.

asha: embeds are billed per embedding call (per-vector) primarily. if a customer chunks a long doc before embedding we'll also account for input tokens used in that chunking process — so you may see both charges. we will publish a conversion/faq table (examples) in the docs this week.

devin: another practical: if a client retries repeatedly during 429 spikes, are they burning credits for each attempt? we've had customers burn through credits with naive retry loops.

policy-bot: System note: failed requests (4xx/5xx) do not consume credits. only successfully completed generation/embedding responses are billed. retries that ultimately succeed will be billed.

emma: to expand on that: transient 429s won't bill, but if a retry eventually succeeds it counts. recommend exponential backoff + jitter in client libs to avoid wasted attempts. we'll add a short example in the client README.

samir: we'll consolidate these Qs into a small FAQ and post to the billing channel and docs. @asha will publish example scenarios (upgrade proration, retry patterns, embed chunking) and we'll pin in Console help.

lina: thanks — :thumbsup:

devin: +1, can infra follow up with per-request logs after you get the IDs, @emma?

emma: yes — drop the IDs in #eng-runtime and i'll route to the traces team.

samir: perfect, thanks everyone. if any customers want an enterprise review of quotas/rate plans, DM me and i'll set up a sync.
